## Web status page

This release refines the mobile web chat introduced in v0.1.10.

### Changes

- Moves daemon details out of the chat stream into a dedicated read-only `/settings` page.
- Adds an accessible cog link in the chat header, plus back and refresh controls on the status page.
- Displays only the existing safe web status fields; paths, invites, capability tokens, and daemon controls remain unavailable.
- Hides composer helper text on narrow mobile screens while keeping send outcomes and errors visible.
- Avoids repeated screen-reader announcements when periodic status polling returns unchanged data.

The security boundary is unchanged: the web server binds to loopback, and private phone access is intended through Tailscale Serve—not Funnel. There is no application login.

See [Mobile web UI](https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/blob/v0.1.11/docs/web.md) for setup and behavior.

### Install

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or install this exact release from source:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg.git \
  --tag v0.1.11 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.10...v0.1.11
